```{r filter to a needed dependent variable}
data_purchase <- data.frame()
# include WTP and purchase probability together
data_purchase <- appliances %>%
  filter(dep_variable_purchase_category %in% c("purschase (probability) of efficient appliance", "WTP for efficient appliance"))
```

```{r meta analysis}
### META-ANALYSIS ###
### PURCHASE PROBABILITY + WTP

### FIXED EFFECTS ###
meta_model1 <- robust(rma(z_value, z_variance, data = data_purchase, method = "FE", mods = ~ intervention+0), cluster = study_ID, clubSandwich = T)
summary(meta_model1)
# fixed effects by intervention

meta_model2 <- robust(rma(z_value, z_variance, data = data_purchase, method = "FE", mods = ~ appliance+0), cluster = study_ID, clubSandwich = T)
summary(meta_model2)
# fixed effects by appliance

### RANDOM EFFECTS ###
meta_model3 <- robust(rma(z_value, z_variance, data = data_purchase, method = "REML", mods = ~ intervention+0), cluster = study_ID, clubSandwich = T)
summary(meta_model3)
# random effects by intervention

meta_model4 <- robust(rma(z_value, z_variance, data = data_purchase, method = "REML", mods = ~ appliance+0), cluster = study_ID, clubSandwich = T)
summary(meta_model4)
# random effects by appliance

### MULTI-LEVEL MODEL ###
meta_model5 <- robust(rma.mv(z_value, z_variance, mods =  ~ intervention+0,
                               random = ~ as.factor(sr_no) | as.factor(study_ID), data = data_purchase, method = "REML"), cluster = study_ID, clubSandwich = T)
summary(meta_model5)
# random effects multi-level by intervention

### INTERACTION INTERVENTION X APPLIANCE ###
data_purchase1 <- data_purchase %>%
  filter(appliance %in% c("Refrigerator", "Lighting", "Water Heater", "Air-Conditioner"))

meta_model7 <- robust(rma.mv(z_value, z_variance, mods =  ~ intervention_category:appliance+0, 
                               random = ~ as.factor(sr_no) | as.factor(study_ID), data = data_purchase1, method = "REML"), cluster = study_ID, clubSandwich = T)
summary(meta_model7)
# random effects multi-level interaction between intervention category and appliance
```

```{r forest plot}
### AVERAGE EFFECT PLOT ### 

coef_summary5 <- coef(summary(meta_model5))

rownames(coef_summary5) <- c("Information \n(n = 68)","Label \n(n = 77)","Loan \n(n = 12)","Rebate \n(n = 31)","Subsidy \n(n = 27)")

average_estimate5 <- mean(coef_summary5$estimate)
ggplot(coef_summary5,
       aes(x = row.names(coef_summary5), y = estimate)) +
  geom_linerange(aes(ymin = ci.lb, ymax = ci.ub),
                 size = 1.5, alpha = 1, colour = "red")  +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = average_estimate5, linetype = "dashed", color = "black", size = 1) +
  annotate("text", x = 3.5, y = average_estimate5 - 0.05, label = paste("Average:", round(average_estimate5, 2)), size = 4.5) + 
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(-0.15, 0.35)) +
  labs(x = "", y = "z-value") +
  ylim(-.2, 0.31)+
  theme_bw() +
  theme(text = element_text(size = 20))
ggsave("interventions_forest.png")

coef_summary6 <- coef(summary(meta_model6))

rownames(coef_summary6) <- c("Air-Conditioner \n(n = 31)","Clothes Dryer \n(n = 6)","Dishwasher \n(n = 4)","Heat Pump \n(n = 18)","Lighting \n(n = 23)","Refrigerator \n(n = 54)","TV \n(n = 12)","Washing Machine \n(n = 13)","Water Heater \n(n = 43)")

average_estimate6 <- mean(coef_summary6$estimate)
ggplot(coef_summary6,
       aes(x = row.names(coef_summary6), y = estimate)) +

                 size = 1.5, alpha = 1, colour = "red")  + 
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = average_estimate6, linetype = "dashed", color = "black", size = 1) +

  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(-0.15, 0.35)) +

funnel(
  data_purchase$z_value, 
  v = data_purchase$z_variance,
  ylim = c(0, 0.3),
  col = intervention_colors[as.factor(data_purchase$intervention_category)], 
  legend = FALSE # We'll create the legend manually
)

# # causes error -- Tarun
# # Create the legend manually using the legend() function
# legend("topright", # Position of the legend
#        legend = levels(as.factor(data_purchase$intervention_category)), # Legend labels
#        # col = my_colors, # Legend colors
#        # pch = 15, # Point type (change if needed)
#        title = "Intervention" # Legend title (change if needed)
# )

data_purchase$se = (data_purchase$z_variance)^(1/2)

meta <-robust(rma.mv(z_value, z_variance, # add all moderator variables
                               random = ~ as.factor(sr_no) | as.factor(study_ID), data = data_purchase, method = "REML"), cluster = study_ID, clubSandwich = T)
summary(meta)

meta_egger <-robust(rma.mv(z_value, z_variance, mods =  ~ se, # add all moderator variables
                               random = ~ as.factor(sr_no) | as.factor(study_ID), data = data_purchase, method = "REML"), cluster = study_ID, clubSandwich = T)
summary(meta_egger)

meta_egger_1 <-robust(rma.mv(z_value, z_variance, mods =  ~z_variance , # add all moderator variables
                               random = ~ as.factor(sr_no) | as.factor(study_ID), data = data_purchase, method = "REML"), cluster = study_ID, clubSandwich = T)
summary(meta_egger_1)

meta_egger1 <-robust(rma.mv(z_value, z_variance, mods =  ~ 0+intervention+se,
                               random = ~ as.factor(sr_no) | as.factor(study_ID), data = data_purchase, method = "REML"), cluster = study_ID, clubSandwich = T)
summary(meta_egger1)

meta_egger1_1 <-robust(rma.mv(z_value, z_variance, mods =  ~ 0+intervention+se^2,
                               random = ~ as.factor(sr_no) | as.factor(study_ID), data = data_purchase, method = "REML"), cluster = study_ID, clubSandwich = T)
summary(meta_egger1_1)

meta_egger2_2 <-robust(rma.mv(z_value, z_variance, mods =  ~ 0+appliance+se,
                               random = ~ as.factor(sr_no) | as.factor(study_ID), data = data_purchase, method = "REML"), cluster = study_ID, clubSandwich = T)
summary(meta_egger2_2)

# bias correction
meta_egger3 <-robust(rma.mv(z_value, z_variance, mods =  ~ 0+intervention+z_variance, 
                               random = ~ as.factor(sr_no) | as.factor(study_ID), data = data_purchase, method = "REML"), cluster = study_ID, clubSandwich = T)
summary(meta_egger3)

meta_egger4 <-robust(rma.mv(z_value, z_variance, mods =  ~ 0+appliance+z_variance, 
                               random = ~ as.factor(sr_no) | as.factor(study_ID), data = data_purchase, method = "REML"), cluster = study_ID, clubSandwich = T)
summary(meta_egger4)

robust_model <- robust(meta_egger3, cluster = study_ID, clubSandwich = TRUE, vcov = "CR2")
summary(robust_model)

# Information, Label = Rebate --> Yes! cannot reject the null of equivalence
constraints <-  rbind(c(1, 0, 0, -1,0, 0), c(0, 1, 0, -1,0, 0))  # Example for comparing level A and B to level C
wald_test <- Wald_test(robust_model, constraints = constraints, vcov = "CR2") 
wald_test

# Information, Label = Subsidy --> Yes! cannot reject the null
constraints <-  rbind(c(1, 0, 0, 0,-1, 0), c(0, 1, 0, 0,-1, 0))  # Example for comparing level A and B to level C
wald_test <- Wald_test(robust_model, constraints = constraints, vcov = "CR2") 
wald_test

# Information, Label = Loan --> No! reject the null
constraints <-  rbind(c(1, 0, -1, 0, 0, 0), c(0, 0, -1, 0, 0, 0))  # Example for comparing level A and B to level C
wald_test <- Wald_test(robust_model, constraints = constraints, vcov = "CR2") 
wald_test

# Compare the full and reduced models 
reduced_meta_egger3 <-robust(rma.mv(z_value, z_variance, mods =  ~ I(intervention != c("Rebate"))+0+z_variance,
                           random = ~ as.factor(sr_no) | as.factor(study_ID), data = data_purchase, method = "ML"), cluster = study_ID, clubSandwich = TRUE, vcov = "CR2")
anova_results <- anova(robust_model, reduced_meta_egger3, refit = T) 
print(anova_results)

# Compare the full and reduced models 
reduced_meta_egger3 <-robust(rma.mv(z_value, z_variance, mods =  ~ I(intervention != c("Loan"))+0+z_variance,
                           random = ~ as.factor(sr_no) | as.factor(study_ID), data = data_purchase, method = "ML"), cluster = study_ID, clubSandwich = TRUE, vcov = "CR2")
anova_results <- anova(robust_model, reduced_meta_egger3, refit = T) 
print(anova_results)

```

```{r prepare for BMA}
# create a list of control variables
# data_purchase$n_interventions <- as.factor(data_purchase$n_interventions)
controlvars <- c( 
                  # "counterfactual",
                  # "n_interventions",
                 "intervention",
                 "appliance",
                 # "continent",
                 # "OECD",
                 "statistical_technique",
                 "study_design",
                 "incentive_follow_through",
                 "experimental_setting",
                   "participant_type",
                 "aware_of_study",
                 "opt_in",
                 "randomisation_dummy",
                 "outOfSampleBias",
                 "reportingBiases",
                 "controls_energy_prices",
                 "controls_environmental_attitudes",
                 "controls_demographics")

metregvar <- c("z_value", "z_variance")
dfbms <- data_purchase  %>% select(all_of(metregvar))
dfbms <- ungroup(dfbms)
dfbms <- dfbms %>% select(-c(study_ID))
# dfbms <- mutate_if(dfbms, is.character, as.numeric)
# dfbms <- mutate_if(dfbms, is.logical, as.numeric)
```

```{r prepare for BMA}
# BMA data preparation 
# create binary variables for all control factor variables

# iterate over each factor variable
for (var_name in controlvars) {
  
  # get unique factor levels
  
  levels <- unique(data_purchase[[var_name]])
  
  # create binary variables for each factor level
  for (level in levels[-1]) {
    # create a new column name by appending the factor level to the variable name
    new_col_name <- paste(var_name, level, sep = "_")
    
    # create a binary variable for the current factor level
    dfbms[[new_col_name]] <- as.numeric(data_purchase[[var_name]] == level)
  }
}

names(dfbms) <- gsub(" ", "_", names(dfbms))
dfbms <- mutate_if(dfbms, is.character, as.numeric)
dfbms <- mutate_if(dfbms, is.logical, as.numeric)
summary(dfbms)
```

```{r ! run BMA -- Tarun to review this cell}
percent = bms(dfbms, burn=1e5,iter=3e5, g="UIP", mprior="uniform", nmodel=50000, mcmc="bd", user.int=FALSE)
percent1 = bms(dfbms, burn=1e5,iter=3e5, g="UIP", mprior="dilut", nmodel=50000, mcmc="bd", user.int=FALSE)
percent2 = bms(dfbms, burn=1e5,iter=3e5, g="BRIC", mprior="random", nmodel=50000, mcmc="bd", user.int=FALSE)

coef <- as.data.frame(coef(percent, order.by.pip = T, exact=T, yprop2pip=T, include.constant=T))

image(percent, yprop2pip=FALSE, order.by.pip=T, do.par=TRUE, do.grid=TRUE, do.axis=TRUE, cex.axis = 0.7)
summary(percent)

coef1 <- as.data.frame(coef(percent1, order.by.pip = F, exact=T, include.constant=T))
coef2 <- as.data.frame(coef(percent2, order.by.pip = F, exact=T, include.constant=T))
coeff <- cbind(coef, coef1, coef2)
print(coeff)
write.table(coeff,"BMA_estimates.csv")

############## ROBUSTNESS CHECKS  OLS-Frequentist###################################################

levels(data_purchase$intervention) <- gsub(" ", "_", levels(data_purchase$intervention))
levels(data_purchase$statistical_technique) <- gsub(" ", "_", levels(data_purchase$statistical_technique))
levels(data_purchase$appliance) <- gsub(" ", "_", levels(data_purchase$appliance))
levels(data_purchase$incentive_follow_through) <- gsub(" ", "_", levels(data_purchase$incentive_follow_through))
levels(data_purchase$participant_type) <- gsub(" ", "_", levels(data_purchase$participant_type))
levels(data_purchase$reportingBiases) <- gsub(" ", "_", levels(data_purchase$reportingBiases))
levels(data_purchase$outOfSampleBias) <- gsub(" ", "_", levels(data_purchase$outOfSampleBias))

data_purchase$participant_type <- relevel(data_purchase$participant_type, ref = "residents")
data_purchase$intervention1 <- relevel(data_purchase$intervention, ref = "Rebate")

levels(data_purchase$intervention1)[levels(data_purchase$intervention1) %in% c("Information", "Label")] <- "Info"

topmod<- lm(z_value ~ intervention1+z_variance+appliance+ incentive_follow_through+reportingBiases+
              participant_type+statistical_technique+outOfSampleBias+0

            ,data = data_purchase)
coeff_top<- coef_test(topmod, vcov = "CR1", cluster = data_purchase$study_ID, test = "naive-t")
coeff_top
write.table(coeff_top,"Fcheck.csv")
```
